paraphrase: Added premise, not attributed to Aristotle: if the natural motion of a thing not moved by itself (as of the light and the heavy) has a per accidens mover, such as the remover of a hindrance, it also has a per se mover in that respect. Physics VIII.4, 255b35-256a2 gives only the inclusive disjunction 'by the generator or by the remover', which admits a motion moved only by the remover; 254b33-255a1, which places such motion among things moved by another, bears on the premise but does not state it.
